question: A spherical ball of radius 3 cm, is immersed in water contained in a vertical cylinder of radius 5 cm. Assuming the water covers the ball completely, what is the rise in the water level (in cm, up to two decimal places)?
solution:

A spherical ball of radius 3 cm, is immersed in water contained in a vertical cylinder of radius 5 cm.
